scripts.build:frontend: cd synthetic-nature && npm ci && npm run build && npm run gzip:dist
scripts.start:prod: npm run build && pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs --env production
scripts.test: tsx tests/agent-tools.test.ts && tsx tests/project-fix.test.ts && tsx tests/project-idor.test.ts && tsx tests/crypto-store.test.ts && tsx synthetic-nature/src/lib/keyVault.test.ts && tsx synthetic-nature/src/lib/vaultRecovery.test.ts && tsx synthetic-nature/src/lib/modelPeer.test.ts && tsx tests/model-sync.test.ts
scripts.deploy: npm run build:frontend && git add synthetic-nature/dist && git commit -m "chore: deploy front-end build $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')" && git push enzo-beta main
